content:
中文: (此模组非我原创) 此模组是"鬼灭之刃"模组的扩展包
即一款基于《鬼灭之刃》漫画和动画的模组。
此模组增加了多种恶魔之血术，例如鸣女的技能（在原"鬼灭之刃"模组中缺失）
以及许多其他自定义的血之艺术

英文: (this mod is not mine) this mod is an expansion for the mod "kimetsu no yaiba"
that is a mod based on the manga and anime of demon slayer.
this mod adds several demon blood arts for example that of nakime (missing in the mod kimetsu no yaiba)
and many other custom blood arts     (scuse for my terrible english)
